prescript.hint: Encrypted with the master password (they can hold tokens). Run in the same shell as the script, in the project folder: your shell ($SHELL: bash, zsh or fish; otherwise bash) on macOS and Linux, cmd on Windows. Exported variables, nvm use, cd also apply to the script. If a command fails the script doesn't start (with fish the last one counts: chain with and). A script's prescript replaces the project's.
